items.title: Anthropic turns Claude Artifacts into standalone desktop apps for macOS and Windows
items.summary: Anthropic now lets you install Claude Artifacts as desktop apps on Mac and Windows, and a free account is enough. You build one in chat without writing code, and it can add menu bar items, send notifications, and create transparent windows. The article Anthropic turns Claude Artifacts into standalone desktop apps for macOS and Windows appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Anthropic tops 700 million monthly MCP SDK downloads and expands the protocol for more autonomous AI agents
items.summary: Two years after launch, Anthropic reports more than 700 million monthly downloads for its MCP interface standard. New features such as background tasks, follow-up questions for users, and file uploads are meant to let Claude work more independently. The article Anthropic tops 700 million monthly MCP SDK downloads and expands the protocol for more autonomous AI agents appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Novartis CEO says AI will shave four years off drug development, not cure all disease
items.summary: Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan, who also sits on Anthropic's board, is pushing back on the cure-all promises from Anthropic CEO Amodei and DeepMind founder Hassabis. AI will speed up drug development, he says, but it won't beat cancer in a decade. The real value lies "somewhere in the middle." The article Novartis CEO says AI will shave four years off drug development, not cure all disease appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: OpenAI o1 co-creator Noam Brown urges promising students to drop out as AI enters a "very steep rate of progress"
items.summary: OpenAI researcher Noam Brown is urging promising students to drop out, saying it's "not a great time to sit on the sidelines." The o1 co-creator says AI is still in a "centaur period" and struggles with planning and self-correction, though he expects a "very steep rate of progress" soon. items.title: Anthropic researcher stands by his AI-assisted Riemann proof but owns up to "stupid things" in the rollout
items.summary: Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge is walking back parts of his announcement of an AI-assisted proof of the generalized Riemann hypothesis. The claim that it ran to more than 250,000 pages was a joke, he says, and the published Lean code is "full of garbage." He still stands by the math. The article Anthropic researcher stands by his AI-assisted Riemann proof but owns up to "stupid things" in the rollout appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Dozens of insiders say OpenAI and Anthropic's unreleased models have outgrown their safety measures
items.summary: According to an Axios report, many employees at OpenAI and Anthropic believe the companies' own unreleased frontier models can no longer be safely controlled. Both companies are internally debating whether to halt releases or even stop training altogether, while employee trust in leadership is eroding. The article Dozens of insiders say OpenAI and Anthropic's unreleased models have outgrown their safety measures appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: German researchers call for computer science to reinvent itself as "Computer and AI Science"
items.summary: In a position paper, TU Darmstadt researchers call for redefining computer science as "Computer and AI Science." Their biggest concern is code generated on the fly at runtime, which they say upends today's safety and correctness guarantees. The article German researchers call for computer science to reinvent itself as "Computer and AI Science" appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude Ship lets AI agents review, fix, and approve pull requests on their own
items.summary: Anthropic has introduced Claude Ship, a new tool currently in beta that automatically reviews, corrects, and approves suggestions for code changes in accordance with team guidelines. The article Anthropic's Claude Ship lets AI agents review, fix, and approve pull requests on their own appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably
items.summary: OpenAI is making GPT-6.2 Sol the new default model in ChatGPT's chat tab, rolling it out worldwide. In internal tests, image understanding jumped from 47.4 to 71.7 percent, and the model now handles difficult instructions correctly 78.1 percent of the time. items.title: Anthropic's appetite for compute is pushing xAI toward a rent-over-build strategy
items.summary: Since May, SpaceXSI has been renting compute to competitors like Anthropic and Google while scaling back its own AI projects. Anthropic pays about $3.1 billion a month, Google $800 million, the New York Times reports. After its June IPO, SpaceXSI disbanded the 60-person Grok Imagine team, among other cuts.
